metadata.note: The Wisconsin Central / Soo Line passenger route from Chicago's Grand Central Station through Wheeling and Waukesha to Neenah, Stevens Point and Owen, then west to St. Paul and Minneapolis and north to Superior and Duluth -- the route of the Laker and of Nos. 1/2. Before this layer the map drew no Soo Line or Wisconsin Central track at all. Each leg is split by operator (Rule 4): Wisconsin Central, the Northern Pacific lease 1889-1893, Wisconsin Central again, and the Soo Line from the 1909 lease. Two realignments are drawn as separate features: the 1910 Spencer - Owen cutoff (replacing the line via Abbotsford) and the 1911 St. Croix High Bridge line (replacing the 1884 low-bridge line). Today the Chicago - Antioch stretch carries Metra's North Central Service, which is a separate Metra feature (metra.geojson).
